clerk_path.zh: 去上夜班 → 进货(牛奶/面包/烟/茶/面/电池) → 开始值班 → 老板短信知道了 → 林阿姨卖出 → 王师傅卖出 → 展开纸条 → 周晓晚卖面 → 湿发多看一眼→还是卖给他 → 吴保安请喝水 → 灯调亮 → 先睡到傍晚 ×6 间夜：拒草莓奶、不卖香、拒纸钱、收手电、不让后间、不热饭盒、收下桃子、拒二次纸钱、不开门、放钥匙、走到门口等天亮 → 看看后来
clerk_path.en: Take the night shift → restock → Start shift → Got it → sell Auntie Lin → sell Wang → Unfold the slip → Zhou noodles → Look again → Sell to him anyway → Offer Wu water → lights up → Sleep till evening; nights 2–7: no strawberry, don't sell incense, don't take joss, take flashlight, no back room, don't heat, peaches, still don't sell, three taps, put keys down, walk to door wait for dawn → See afterward

ending_source: seven public nights then settle primary button (看看后来 / See afterward) → game finish(pickEnding(state)). Not __ns.finish. Not skip-to-dawn.
near_fail: 湿发男人公开选项「多看一眼」后「还是卖给他 / Sell to him anyway」。then 文案「好看吗」+干纸币+电池小票。flags.lookedWet。renderChoices 只打 choice，截图时 .choice.warn=0。未 classList.add('warn')，未改 sanity 字段。
